basic_info.description: Welcome to your dream house in sunny Noe Valley. This lovingly cared-for 3BD/2BA property blends original charm with modern comforts. Upstairs is a spacious kitchen with a Viking range and an attached dining area, ideal for casual meals and entertaining. The sun-splashed living room is highlighted with the original parquet floors and fireplace. The main level has 2 large bedrooms, with skyline views, a private deck, and a full bathroom. The massive primary suite, downstairs is a private oasis with an en-suite bathroom, a walk-in closet, and outdoor access. The majestic backyard is a rare find. Lush, private, and lovingly landscaped with mature trees, flowering rhododendrons, and peaceful seating areas. 1-car garage and an additional bonus room ideal for office, gym, or play area complete this home. Don't miss the opportunity to own this skyline beauty with storybook serenity.
